values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754125 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0', 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754125 (Restrictions: 'Vehicle Length Trailer Length is 25ft.'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754125 (Restrictions: 'Stay Limit Maximum stay of 7 days'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists a toilet (type not stated), primitive campsites and a gravel boat ramp (non-motorized boating); no drinking water listed. ADA accessibility rated 'Difficult'.

facilities.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754125 (Facilities: 'Toilet', 'Primitive Campsite', 'Ramp (Gravel)'; Activities 'Boating - non-motorized'; ADA Accessibility 'Difficult Accessibility'), read 2026-10-22

note: Montana FWP fishing access site (179 acres, ~4,040 ft) on the Blackfoot River with designated primitive camping. Directions (FWP): 38 miles east of Bonner on Hwy 200, turn southeast on an unmarked county road for 9 rough miles, follow the signs. FWP: 'Road to site is somewhat rough.' --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page: confirmed $12/$18 FAS camping, toilet, primitive campsites, gravel ramp; added the 25-ft trailer length and 7-day stay limit. Year-round season (manual) unchanged. Not stated: site count, toilet type, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left), hookups (derived electric 0 left). Note: dropped 'No trailer length limit published by FWP' (the page gives 25 ft) and restated facilities/FCFS/fees; FWP's rough-road caveat added.
